performance.title: First Contentful Paint
performance.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).
performance.why: The first visible content is taking 3.9 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.
performance.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint
performance.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)
performance.why: The main visible content is taking 3.9 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.
performance.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

performance.title: First Contentful Paint
performance.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).
performance.why: The first visible content is taking 4.1 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.
performance.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint
performance.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)
performance.why: The main visible content is taking 4.1 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.
performance.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

performance.title: Speed Index

performance.fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

performance.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint

issues.fix: Check the URL "https://www.facebook.com/searchonic/", correct the destination if necessary, and remove or replace the broken link.

issues.title: Link could not be fully verified: https://www.linkedin.com/company/searchonic/
issues.why: The destination returned HTTP 999. This can mean that the server requires authentication, blocks automated requests, applies rate limiting, or uses bot protection.
issues.fix: Manually open "https://www.linkedin.com/company/searchonic/" in a normal browser and confirm that the destination works before marking this link as broken.

performance.title: First Contentful Paint
performance.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/first-contentful-paint/).
performance.why: The first visible content is taking 4.0 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.
performance.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint
performance.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)
performance.why: The main visible content is taking 4.0 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.
performance.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

performance.title: Speed Index
performance.description: Speed Index shows how quickly the contents of a page are visibly populated. [Learn more about the Speed Index metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/speed-index/).
performance.why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (7.4 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.
performance.fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

performance.title: Use efficient cache lifetimes

performance.fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

performance.title: Reduce unused CSS

seo.title: Links are not crawlable
seo.description: Search engines may use `href` attributes on links to crawl websites. Ensure that the `href` attribute of anchor elements links to an appropriate destination, so more pages of the site can be discovered. seo.fix: Use standard <a href="..."> links with valid destination URLs.
